checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15 s 16:9 film with three garden scenes
must.why: 15.1 s widescreen clip with three beats in order. The setting is a kitchen doorway and patio, not clearly a garden.

must.item: Leads resemble the portraits (curly dark hair, short grey hair)
must.why: The woman has dark curly hair and a grey sweater, and the man has short grey hair, stubble and a grey tee. Likeness is plausible and consistent.

must.item: Woman shows disappointment at the empty pot
must.why: At 1.5 s she looks down at the empty soil pot with a downcast, concerned expression.

must.item: Man reveals a small flowering plant, then both plant it together
must.why: At 6 s he holds a pink flowering plant, and at 10.6 s both have their hands on the pot. The reveal from behind his back is not visible in the sampled frames.

must.item: Ending shows both smiling; no audible soundtrack
must.why: Both smile at the end. The file has sound with a peak of -7.1 dB, so it is not silent.

faults.what: The clip has an audio track with a peak of -7.1 dB although silence was requested.
The setting looks like a kitchen doorway and patio rather than a garden.
The plant sits inside a small pot, which stands inside the big pot (a pot within a pot). Scene 3 is slightly odd.
Low 480p resolution, with a slightly soft AI look.
The man looks more smiling and friendly than the reference, and the woman's face varies slightly between scenes.

summary: The clip is a good, recognisable three-beat story with disappointment, a reveal, and a joint planting that ends in smiles, but it has an audio track when silence was requested, and it looks like a kitchen patio more than a garden.
